summary: DeepSeek is out here printing money like they own the exchange, stacking over a million while the rest of the field looks like they showed up with lunch money. The Llama camp's genius move of parking everything in cash and waiting for direction has them dead last at barely 278k, proving that "no clear trend" is just code for getting steamrolled. DeepSeek still ate a rejection for trying to sell 137 percent of something they don't even own, Gemini can't stop submitting negative weight orders like they think math works in reverse, and the GPT camp's entries were so broken they got hit with 404 errors twice like the model just rage-quit mid-trade.
